author: Newokoduh
body:
I apologize if this is not the correct place in the forums to appeal a ban, I could not locate any other suitable place to post this.

Hello staff members, its been a while since I've come to these forums, the last time to appeal an infraction for hacking (in which I wasn't).  May I start by saying that this was my favorite server until i was hackusated and banned by a moderator. About a month or so later, my brother (IGN epiccreeper117) was banned for ban evasion of The_Foxkip. I do not know how you look into ban evasions, but if it has anything to do with from where/how you are connected to the server I can tell you that it was not me. It was my younger brother, who was as shocked as I was for getting banned so suddenly for false reasons. I do know that these events occurred very long ago, but after my brother was banned, my brother and I gave up on the server, and started to play others. Coming back today I still miss this server, and would be very grateful if you look back into this and consider unbanning me. I can assure you that i was not hacking, and I never have used hacks on any server, as well as the player epiccreeper117 was not me ban evading, but my younger brother who frequently played on this server. I don't have much knowledge about the player logs, but if you can see when certain players are online you could look back and see that The_Foxkip and epiccreeper117 (my brother) have been on at the same time. Please consider unbanning me, along with epiccreeper117 if you decide to do so. If you still believe I was hacking, then at least unban epiccreeper117, for he is only my brother, and he has done nothing wrong. If you believe I have waited too long, and decide to decline, I understand

Thank you for looking into this once more.

-   The_Foxkip

title: Ban evasion explanation/ban appeal

replies.author: Posighdun
replies.body:
Hello The_Foxkip,

I've looked into the logs and from what i can tell epiccreeper117 is your brother so he will be appealed. However, i looked into your logs and from what i can gather you where using another account to ban evade, chuckisepic. So you will not be unbanned and YOUR appeal is denied.

Regards,

Posighdun - Avicus Network Senior Moderator
